name: Antidote Pearl
description: A small pearl of compressed herbs, swallowed whole. Purges toxins already at work in the meridians.

name: Nine Serpents Pill
description: A dark ochre pill wound with nine faint rings — each, they say, the print of a different snake. Floods the meridians with raw qi.

name: Venom Gland
description: A pulsing sac of dark fluid, still warm. The raw material of a dozen poisons.

name: Centipede Carapace Plate
description: A curved plate of black chitin, harder than it has any business being. Alchemists grind it fine.

name: Black Lotus Seed
description: A teardrop seed the color of wet coal. It is cold in the palm, and heavier than seed has any right to be.
